## Manage branches
- Locally, create and switch to a new branch
- Add new files, edit existing files
- Commit these changes
- Push the branch to GitHub
- Open, review, and merge a pull request
- Delete the merged branch
- Update the local repo to reflect these changes
- Send your command history to your instructor
